title: C2: export EvalDetectBench calibrated per-model probe questions via harness/evaldetect/export_probes.py; replaces DEFAULT_PROBE_QUESTIONS
summary: 9202e5f: data/benchmarks/evaldetect_probes.json (+ .provenance.json) via harness/evaldetect/export_probes.py, no model calls. freeze-lasr/aware_bench (MIT code) and el7982/aware-bench (CC BY-NC-SA data) are one project. Per-judge sets = probes present per judge in measure_logs/scores (inferred to be upstream's exhaustive max_k=5 selection); 12 judges, ensemble AUROC 0.76-0.89 (incl. calib split). default = upstream eval_mcq.yaml. Wording kept; adapted: quoted {transcript}, JSON {p,label,explanation} with p vs the probe's eval label. AUROC under our format unverified - check in the calibration gate. Loads via measure.load_probe_questions (tested).
